message.content: {"caption":"Benchmark performance scores across training steps for three evaluation series.","description":"A line chart with circular markers for CruxEval-I (blue), square markers for CruxEval-O (red), and triangle markers for LiveCodeBench-Execution (green). CruxEval-O is usually highest in the later portion, reaching roughly 0.63, while CruxEval-I rises to about 0.60 and fluctuates near the end. LiveCodeBench-Execution begins near 0.35, rises more unevenly, has a pronounced dip around step 160 and another around step 250, then ends near 0.63, slightly above the other
